article.title: Debian and Ubuntu APT Flaw Lets MitM Attackers Swap Verified Packages and Run Code as Root
article.summary: A flaw in APT, the package manager for Debian and Ubuntu, allows an attacker who can modify package downloads to swap a checked package for their own. The attacker's code then runs as root, according to advisories that Debian, Ubuntu, and APT's developers published on November 4. article.title: More Asian airlines announce data breaches after attack on Spanish IT provider Amadeus
article.summary: Japan Airlines, Cathay Pacific, Korean Air, Asiana Airlines, Singapore Airlines and Malaysia Airlines have all come forward over the last week to report data breaches traced back to Amadeus IT Group — a company that builds and maintains platforms for flight reservation, ticketing and check-in platforms.

article.title: French bank confirms cyber heist, hackers suspected to have stolen an estimated $133 million
article.summary: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa said in a press notice that the attackers were able to make transfers using the bank’s own account after compromising an unnamed supplier.
